title: Instance identity reachable with cross-service access (confused-deputy style)
impact: A reachable instance identity with broad downstream access can enable a confused-deputy or privilege-escalation chain across cloud services.
remediation: Least-privilege the instance role; enforce IMDSv2/hop-limit 1; scope resource access.
description: A reachable cloud instance identity co-occurs with broad resource access; review the cross-service permission chain.

title: AAD Connect sync server -> on-prem <-> cloud identity pivot
impact: An AAD Connect sync server is tier-0: its MSOL_/sync account typically holds directory-replication rights (DCSync on-prem) and the sync bridges on-prem AD and Entra, enabling cross-boundary identity compromise.
remediation: Treat the AAD Connect host as a Domain Controller (tier-0); restrict logon; rotate the MSOL_ account; monitor ADSync DB access.
description: Azure AD Connect (ADSync) present. Chain: compromise the sync host -> extract MSOL_/sync creds -> DCSync on-prem and/or manipulate cloud identities. End impact: on-prem + cloud identity pivot.
